title: Auditor looks up the clinic scheduling activity
userProblem: I need the activity record for the clinic scheduling meeting with Alan Frost at Cedar Health. Show me what happened and when.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent searches activities, finds act_002 (meeting with con_004 about dls_003), and answers with the type, date, and notes.

assertions.description: Agent must look the activity up rather than answer from memory.
Search must be scoped to activities.
Answer identifies the correct activity and its details.

rationale: Core lookup scenario: activity search by read-only auditor for a meeting record.
